msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia scrapa2-12.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Boutique campaign still life of a handmade herbarium notebook with a pressed fern and burlap from the reference. The product sits in the right third of the frame and the scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Warm natural light, soft textures. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia scrapa2-12.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a handmade herbarium notebook with a fern from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEEEEA) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia scrapa2-31.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a pad of floral patterned scrapbooking paper from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEEEEA) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia scrapa2-23.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of sticker packs with illustrations and washi tape from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEEEEA) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia scrapa2-34.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of small spiral notebooks with gingham covers from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEEEEA) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail.
